lemmas.primary_translation: to be extremely poor / to earn very little

definitions.translation: to be extremely poor (lit. not have/earn enough for the salt in one's food)

examples.no: fiskerne har ikke til salt i maten
examples.en: the fishermen cannot afford even the salt for their food

examples.no: arbeiderne tjente ikke til salt i maten
examples.en: the workers did not earn enough even for the salt in their food
